verdict.rationale: Aircall is a SaaS telephony platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a Public API, OAuth, webhooks and a Postman collection, with no MCP server or MCP endpoint mentioned. The REST API is at most a developer building block, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
